people.name: Ornan
people.line: Jebusite, sold threshing floor to David

translations.web: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May Yahweh your God accept you.”
translations.bsb: O king, Araunah gives all these to the king.” He also said to the king, “May the LORD your God accept you.”
translations.kjv: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.
translations.asv: all this, O king, doth Araunah give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, Jehovah thy God accept thee.
